Bill.BriefDescription: Providing the crime of threats with a firearm against persons in places of education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to threats with a firearm against persons involvedin school activities; adding a new section to chapter 9.41 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It shall be unlawful for any person, acting alone or withothers, to threaten to use a firearm against any persons on public orprivate elementary or secondary school premises, schoolprovidedtransportation, or areas of facilities while being used exclusively bypublic or private schools, who are engaged in the peaceful discharge oftheir studies, duties, or activities; or to communicate or repeat anyinformation concerning such a threatened use of a firearm, knowing suchinformation to be false and with intent to alarm the person or personsto whom the information is communicated or repeated. (2) It shall not be a defense to any prosecution under this sectionthat the threatened use of a firearm was a hoax. p. 1 HB 2824 (3) A violation of this section is a class B felony punishableaccording to chapter 9A.20 RCW.
